_readme: INTEGRATION FIXTURE. A test asset, not a seed: `data/` stays the
only seed directory and `scripts/seed.ts` its only reader. The
integration seed reads this directory and nothing under `data/`,
on top of a `db:seed` pass that has already written the domain.
This file carries `llm_calls` rows. The web keeps no calls module:
its spend module holds only the week's sum, `TOKENS_USED_THIS_WEEK`,
so these rows are the calls that sum is made of. Every `estTokens`
whose `calledAt` falls in `[2026-06-08T00:00:00.000Z,
2026-06-11T14:30:00.000Z)`, the Monday that opens the week of the
web's `FIXTURE_NOW` up to that instant, adds to exactly 1042800.
Keys beginning with an underscore are commentary, not columns.
The table has no `domain_id` and no natural key, and these rows carry
no id of their own. `runFixtureId` names a row of `runs.json` by its
`fixtureId`, or is null for a call no pass made. `node` is the
workflow node that records such a call and `model` the `model` of
the `connectors.json` row a pass of that node reads.
`estTokens` is `ceil(promptChars / 4)`, what `estimateTokens` in
`src/lib/chunk.ts` computes, and `promptChars` is not always a
multiple of four so the rounding is present in the bundle.
TIMESTAMPS ARE FIXED. `calledAt` is a literal instant inside the run
it names, never derived from the wall clock and never left to the
column's `now()` default. A spend window read against a real clock
therefore finds none of these rows; read it with an explicit `since`
and `until`.
